scope: Public aggregate summary, not raw sensor telemetry. Full new captures and provenance remain local pending permission to publish internal cluster paths.
scene: Two distinct original Blender trees, original UR5e and mock pruner; one selected spur target

failures.reason: Closure quotient at 7.8 seconds was 0.9999999999999994; tracking failed next frame

tracker_replay.scope: Saved-image replay; post-stop images do not prove counterfactual continued motion

limitations: One known target in a two-tree scene, not pruning both trees or a success-rate evaluation
Visual jaw surrogate and discrete PhysX piece release, not actuated CAD blades or wood fracture
Scene metadata supplies initial pixel, identity, axis and radius; depth is simulator ground truth
Capture-rate contact checks do not certify continuous collision avoidance
Tracking loss after completed release is allowed during home-directed retreat
Virtual camera mount and artistic lighting are not hardware or radiometric calibration
